company_overview: Postman is the world’s leading API platform, simplifying the entire API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration for developers. It enables the development, testing, management, and distribution of APIs and services, catering to both engineers and enterprise-scale needs.
target_audience: Developers, API architects, and IT professionals involved in designing, building, and managing APIs, particularly those focused on modern application development and integration.

company_overview: Supabase is a Postgres-based open-source Firebase alternative that provides a fully managed backend for developers building web and mobile applications. It offers a suite of tools including authentication, data APIs, real-time subscriptions, and storage, enabling developers to quickly build and scale their applications.
target_audience: Developers building web and mobile applications, particularly those seeking a flexible, scalable, and easy-to-use backend solution with a strong focus on open-source technologies and Postgres.

company_overview: Vapi is a developer platform that enables businesses to build advanced voice AI agents. It handles the complex infrastructure, allowing companies to focus on creating engaging voice experiences for their customers.
target_audience: Vapi’s target audience includes businesses of all sizes, particularly those seeking to improve customer support, automate workflows, and integrate voice AI into their operations. It caters to enterprises and organizations needing scalable voice agent solutions.
